rules: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Use semantic HTML5 elements (main, section, article).
Focus rings must be visible on all interactive elements.
Status updates must use ARIA live regions for screen readers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'useSound' hook or HTML5 Audio for the Admin Dashboard alert when a new request comes in.
Implement 'Server-Sent Events' (SSE) for real-time updates. Do not use polling.
Ensure the passenger form is broken into logical steps if it gets too long, or use a clean single-page form with clear sections.
The 'Matrícula' lookup must be debounced or triggered by a button to avoid excessive API calls.
Admin password is strictly 'ARC123' (hardcoded for MVP as per request).
Use the abstract blue map as a subtle background for the 'Home' and 'Login' screens, possibly with a dark overlay for text readability.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Export components as named exports, pages as default exports.
